geisa-waveform.$comment: Example waveform stream descriptor exposed through GEISA Platform Discovery. Runtime subscribe and unsubscribe examples are provided in separate files.

stream.$comment: Descriptor metadata for the required baseline waveform stream. Optional name and description values, when present, are platform-supplied informational metadata intended for display, diagnostics, or logging. Applications SHALL NOT rely on these fields for interoperability behavior.
stream.name: Baseline Waveform Stream
stream.description: Baseline interoperable waveform stream for GEISA applications.
